name: Apex
notes: Repo README/SOLVERS/VALIDATORS and docs.macrocosmos.ai miner guide list wallet + submission fees only; no GPU or hardware requirements found.

name: Vanta
quote:
- 2 vCPU + 8 GB memory
- Run the miner using CPU
notes: docs/miner.md System Requirements section tells miners to run on CPU (2 vCPU + 8 GB RAM); no GPU needed.

name: blockmachine
notes: Main repo points to taostat/blockmachine-miner, whose Node Eligibility Requirements cover RPC service correctness per chain; no CPU/GPU/VRAM hardware spec published.

name: Quasar
notes: docs/mining.md supports multi-GPU miners (QUASAR_MINER_DEVICES) but states miner GPU details are telemetry only; no minimum GPU/VRAM published.

name: deprecated
notes: Repo is github.com/deprecated/deprecated; subnet retired, research skipped per batch instructions.

name: Dojo
quote: Miners do not need to spin up any server or code level things to mine!
notes: Mining is register + load hotkey into a browser wallet (dojo.network); README documents no server, code, or GPU for miners.

name: True Performance Network
notes: docs/Miner.md requires only 0.3 TAO collateral; sole hardware note is validator follower mode 'No GPU is required' (leader validators benchmark models).

name: Hippius
notes: Node-setup.md minimum hardware is CPU/RAM/SSD only (4 cores, 16GB RAM, 500GB SSD, 100Mbps) with no GPU; chain defines ComputeMiner/GpuMiner node types but no specs are published.

name: Compelle
quote: Modest CPU. No GPU. Inference is offloaded to Chutes.
notes: Requirements section of the reference validator README explicitly states no GPU; LLM inference runs via the Chutes API.

name: Albedo
notes: docs/MINING.md requirements are hotkey/wallet/upload-credentials/Python >=3.11 only; miners fine-tune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B but no GPU/VRAM spec is documented.

name: ChipForge
notes: docs/Technical_Guide.md has a CPU-only System Requirements table (8 cores/24GB RAM) but it references the old Tatsu Document Understanding subnet (stale copy); no ChipForge GPU spec.

name: Ditto
notes: Actual repo is ditto-assistant/ditto-subnet (found via org page); miners submit Docker agent harnesses and docs/MINER.md plus heyditto.ai state no GPU/hardware requirements.

name: Astrid
notes: Repo is the validator daemon (prerequisites: Node.js 20+ and wallet only); docs/miner-guide.md has no hardware/GPU requirements either.
